exact.收件人与内容都要填: Fill in both the recipient and the message
exact.只列出了最近的往来。: Only the most recent messages are listed.
exact.输入内容，回车换行: Type your message; Enter inserts a line break
exact.不确定该用哪张卡回复。: Not sure which SIM to reply from.
exact.这段对话里收到的那部分已经不在库里了（多半是按保留上限清理的），\n: The incoming half of this conversation is no longer in the database (most likely cleared by the retention limit), so there is no record of which device and which SIM received it.
exact.换一张卡发回去，对方看到的是陌生号码: reply from a different SIM and the other side sees an unfamiliar number
exact.——\n 请自己确认下面选的是对的。: — check for yourself that the selection below is right.
exact.没有在线设备，暂时无法回复。: No device is online, so replying is not possible right now.
exact.请先选一台设备：原消息已不在库里，系统不能替你猜用哪张卡: Pick a device first: the original message is no longer in the database, so the system will not guess which SIM to use
exact.发送记录不存在。: That sent message does not exist.
exact.已交给运营商。停在这一步通常是对方网络没回送达报告，不代表没收到。: Handed to the carrier. Stopping here usually means the other side's network sent no delivery report; it does not mean the message was not received.
exact.还没送到设备。设备离线时会一直停在这里。: Not delivered to the device yet. It stays here for as long as the device is offline.
exact.复制失败，请手动选择: Copy failed — select the text manually
exact.按优先级从小到大匹配。没有规则命中时走兜底：推送到全部启用渠道并归档。: Matched by priority, lowest number first. When no rule matches, the fallback applies: push to every enabled channel and archive.
exact.规则决定「哪些消息发到哪里」，所以得先有个「哪里」。\n 加完渠道: A rule decides which messages go where, so there has to be a "where" first. Add a channel, come back to this page, and a "Write suggested rules" button will appear here to set up all seven at once.
exact.可以一键写入建议规则，按顺序匹配：: You can write the suggested rules in one click. They match in this order:
exact.高优先级、自动提取、穿透专注模式: high priority, auto-extract, breaks through Focus mode
exact.App 推送来的验证码走这条: verification codes that arrive as app notifications go here
exact.本机发出的，只归档不推送: sent from the phone itself; archive only, no push
exact.以上都不是，正常推送: none of the above; pushed normally
exact.单独分组，点击可预填回复: grouped separately; tap to prefill a reply
exact.写进去的推送目标是: The push targets written in are
exact.以后新加的渠道不会自动进来: Channels added later will not be included automatically
exact.，那时候要么在这一页勾一下，\n 要么在渠道页点「加进现有的推: — at that point either tick it on this page, or go to the Channels page and click "Add to existing push rules".
exact.推送目标已失效，命中后不会送达: Push target no longer exists; matches will not be delivered
exact.还没有规则，当前全部走兜底。: No rules yet — everything goes through the fallback.
exact.留空的条件表示不限制。多个条件之间是「都要满足」，同一条件里的多个值是「满足其一: A condition left empty places no restriction. Different conditions all have to match; multiple values within one condition match if any one of them does.
exact.命中任意一个就排除掉，优先于上面的包含。常用来把带「退订」的营销短信挑出去。: Matching any one of these excludes the message, and that wins over "contains" above. Commonly used to filter out marketing SMS carrying "退订" (unsubscribe).
exact.两个都留空表示全天。起点晚于终点表示跨午夜，如 23:00 到 07:00。按「: Leave both empty for all day. A start later than the end means it crosses midnight, e.g. 23:00 to 07:00. Calculated in the timezone set under Settings → Timezone.
exact.勾选后这条规则只对选中的设备生效。不同卡走不同渠道就靠这里，\n: Tick devices and this rule applies only to them. This is how you route different SIMs to different channels: create one rule per SIM.
exact.双卡机上两张卡的用途往往完全不同：一张收银行验证码，\n 一张是垃: On a dual-SIM phone the two cards usually serve completely different purposes: one receives bank verification codes, the other is a spam magnet. Numbers alone will not separate them.
exact.卡槽未知的消息不会命中: Messages with an unknown SIM slot will not match
exact.（老版本 Agent 或系统不给这个信息）。: (older Agent versions, or a system that does not report it).
exact.还没有渠道，去「设置 → 渠道」添加。: No channels yet — add one under Settings → Channels.
exact.一个都不勾 = 只归档不推送。: Tick none = archive only, no push.
exact.命中后不再匹配后续规则: Stop matching further rules after this one
exact.高优先级（推送时出声）: High priority (the push makes a sound)
exact.这几项按消息类型配，所以放在规则里。对非 Bark 渠道无影响。: These settings vary by message type, so they live in the rule. They have no effect on non-Bark channels.
exact.通知中心按分组分栏。多设备时会自动再缀上设备名。: Notification Center separates groups into columns. With several devices the device name is appended automatically.
exact.验证码（需同时开启下方「提取验证码」）: Verification code (also turn on "Extract verification code" below)
exact.不用长按，通知到达即进剪贴板（部分 iOS 版本支持）: No long press — put it on the clipboard as soon as the notification arrives (supported on some iOS versions)
exact.——Service Worker 拿不到剪贴板。\n 验证码只能放: — a Service Worker cannot reach the clipboard. The verification code can only go in the message body. No effect on non-browser channels.
exact.正文开头带上提取出的验证码: Put the extracted verification code at the start of the body
exact.字段与 Bark 那几项对齐，同一条规则在两个渠道上表现一致。对非 ntfy 渠: These fields mirror the Bark ones, so the same rule behaves the same on both channels. No effect on non-ntfy channels.
exact.ntfy 认识一批 emoji 名（如: ntfy understands a set of emoji names (e.g.
exact.），会渲染成 emoji 缀在标题前。: ), rendered as emoji in front of the title.
exact.验证码（需同时开启上方「提取验证码」）: Verification code (also turn on "Extract verification code" above)
exact.对完整发件人做正则匹配。写错的正则会让这条规则永不命中，先用下面的试跑确认。: A regex matched against the full sender. A wrong regex means this rule never matches — confirm with the test run below first.
exact.发件人里出现其中任意一段即可，不用管国际区号前缀。: Any one of these appearing anywhere in the sender is enough; the country-code prefix does not matter.
exact.完整相等才算。带不带 +86 是两个不同的值。: Only an exact match counts. With and without +86 are two different values.
exact.常用于 106 开头的服务号。: Commonly used for service numbers starting with 106.
exact.常用于只认尾号的场景，带不带国际区号都能命中。: Commonly used when only the last digits matter; it matches with or without the country code.
exact.如 验证码，回车添加: e.g. 验证码 — Enter to add
exact.如 退订，回车添加: e.g. 退订 — Enter to add

rules.pattern: ^按最近 (\d+) 条记录归组。更早的记录进到会话里还能继续往前翻。$
rules.to: Grouped from the most recent $1 records. Older ones are still there — open a conversation and keep scrolling back.

rules.pattern: ^(\d+) 字（超过 70 字会拆成多条发送）$
rules.to: $1 characters (over 70 is split into several messages)

rules.pattern: ^已写入 (\d+) 条规则，推送目标：(.+)$
^优先级 (\d+) · (\d+) 个渠道 · 提取验证码$
^优先级 (\d+) · 只归档 · 提取验证码$
^当前只有 (\d+) 台设备，无需限定。多设备时这里可以让不同的卡走不同的渠道。$
rules.to: You only have $1 device, so there is nothing to limit. With several devices this is where you route different SIMs to different channels.
